lessons.title: Constant Velocity & 1D Motion
lessons.description: Establish coordinate reference frames, distinguish scalar distance from vector displacement, and model uniform straight-line motion at constant speed.

lessons.title: Motion Graphs & Uniform Acceleration
lessons.description: Interpret position-time, velocity-time, and acceleration-time graphs using slope and area under the curve to model accelerating bodies and free fall.

lessons.title: Kinematics Equations & 2D Projectiles
lessons.description: Master the Big Three kinematics equations and apply the independence of perpendicular motions to predict 2D horizontal projectile landing zones in Operation Projectile Precision.

lessons.title: Level 1 Solo Trial Review
lessons.description: Comprehensive main ideas digest and targeted practice problems for cadets preparing to retake the Level 1 Solo Trial assessment, with full printable worksheet export.

lessons.title: Newton's First Law & Inertia
lessons.description: Examine reference frames, contact versus field forces, and translational equilibrium to predict motion with zero net force.

lessons.title: Newton's Second Law & Acceleration
lessons.description: Quantify acceleration from net force and mass, resolve multi-axis force systems, and calculate apparent weight in accelerating elevators.

lessons.title: Newton's Third Law & Action-Reaction
lessons.description: Identify mutual interaction pairs, resolve the horse-and-cart paradox, and analyze collision impulse dynamics with force load sensors.

lessons.title: Friction Models & Inclined Planes
lessons.description: Distinguish static and kinetic friction, decompose gravity along tilted axes, and determine critical slip angles on ramps.

lessons.title: Coupled Systems & Atwood Machines
lessons.description: Apply the whole-system method to connected bodies, resolve internal cord tension, and model classical Atwood machines.

lessons.title: Level 2 Solo Trial Review
lessons.description: Comprehensive Level 2 Dynamics formula digest and targeted remediation practice problems with toggleable worked solutions and printable worksheet export.
